title: design
description: A design document, its conclusion first: the background, goals and non-goals, decisions with their options and the one taken, what is decided without options, what it touches, and sections of your own.

status.description: Where the design stands, such as Draft or Approved, stamped under the title

owner.description: Who wrote it or owns it

summary.description: A sentence or two under the title; a line of Markdown

items.description: What it leaves out; a line of Markdown

decisions.description: Each a question and its options; the one taken, marked with pick, heads the page, and one without is undecided

why.description: Why the option taken, or why it is undecided, under it at the top; a line of Markdown

items.description: What is decided without weighing options, such as a rule or a number: a decision's option taken is at the top already; a line of Markdown

what.description: What it touches, such as an API, data or operations; a line of Markdown

more.description: Sections of your own after the rest, each a heading over parts
